visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with glasses and brown hair is seen in an office-like setting; in the foreground, a hand holds small cards with Chinese text and symbols. (2) The setting shifts to a living room with a white coffee table where a white toy water gun and several stacks of cards are prepared for a game. (3) A woman wearing a pink striped shirt and glasses sits on the floor opposite the man; they begin flipping cards to reveal specific Chinese characters and categories. (4) The man reacts with excitement, pointing at the cards, while the woman laughs and leans back in a playful interaction. (5) The man suddenly picks up the water gun and sprays a stream of water toward the woman, who flinches and laughs while covering her face. (6) A new scene titled "The Next Day" shows the man in a black t-shirt setting up the same table; a different woman in a grey t-shirt and glasses sits across from him. (7) Before the game officially begins, the woman grabs the water gun and sprays the man's face, catching him completely off guard. (8) The man stands up, gesturing with his hands in mock frustration while the woman smiles and laughs at her successful pre-emptive prank.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To entertain viewers through a comedic prank vlog featuring a word-guessing game with a water gun punishment. The video relies on the humor of the unpredictable sprays and the creator's exaggerated reactions to being splashed.
